concept: Compute Optimizer: right-sizing and finding idle EC2
tests: Which service provides right-sizing recommendations and identifies idle instances.
expected: AWS Compute Optimizer — ML analysis of utilization metrics, sizing recommendations, idle instances. Triggers: "idle and underutilized", "right-sizing recommendations".
why_not: CloudWatch alarms — threshold alerts without recommendations; CloudTrail — API activity; Shield — DDoS protection.
